title: Change-document front-matter
description: The HTML-comment front-matter block at the top of a repo-level change doc (context/<repo>/changes/CHANGE-<NNN>-*.md) or a project-level index (context/project/changes/PROJECT-CHANGE-<NNN>-*.md). Keys are the <!-- key: value --> lines. See STANDARD-CHANGE.md.

seq.description: Zero-padded sequence number as it appears in the front-matter comment.

csv.description: Comma-separated list of repo names, e.g. 'shared, repo-a, repo-b'.

repoChange.description: status 'complete' is reserved for CHANGE-<NNN>-initial-spec.md baseline records.

projectChange.description: Project-level index. 'consumers' is required in practice only for scope: shared.
